Use:                    The Applicant seeks a zoning change from the current RS3 Residential
                        Single-Unit (Detached House) District to an RMS Residential Multi-Unit
                        District to meet the bulk and density requirements of the RMS District.
                        Subject property is improved with two (2) residential buildings, which
                        will remain. The front building is 2-story residential building containing

                        zoning change will allow the Applicant to rehabilitate the building and
                        legalize its existing rear addition. The rear building is a 3-story building
                        containing three (3) dwelling units and will remain intact.
